title: Affine space of any dimension and preservation of $D^b_c$
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of positive characteristic different from $\ell$, and a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $V$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Fix an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ and a finite intermediate extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and let $\Lambda=E$ or $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Use the pulled-back condensed coefficients of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring; sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], the bounded constructible categories $\Dbc$ of [sk-def-sfb-constructible], and their localizing closures [sk-def-localizing-closure]. For $d\in\mathbf N$ let $p_d:\mathbf A^d_V\to V$ be the projection [def-sbc-affine-space]. Let $p_d^!$ denote the right adjoint to the compactification-defined $Rp_{d,!}$ on these localizing categories [sk-prop-sf-existence]. With the Tate twists of [sk-def-sp-tate-twist], there is a natural isomorphism of functors
$$
p_d^!\simeq p_d^*(d)[2d]:\Loc(\Dbc(V,\Lambda))\longrightarrow\Loc(\Dbc(\mathbf A^d_V,\Lambda)).
$$
Moreover, $p_d^*(d)[2d]$ sends $\Dbc(V,\Lambda)$ into $\Dbc(\mathbf A^d_V,\Lambda)$.

proof.text: Use the zero-coordinate projection isomorphism and the open compact-support adjunction for the base case. Transport its ambient pullback using the proved zero-power tensor/shift isomorphism.

Induct uniformly in the base and compactification. Split the last coordinate, apply the affine-line adjunction over affine d-space, and compose first with the coordinate isomorphism and then with the inductive adjunction. Use the two tensor/pullback/shift composition isomorphisms to identify the ambient right adjoint with the specified degree-(d+1) one.

The constructed adjunction supplies existence. Uniqueness of a right adjoint compares every other exceptional right adjoint with this one. The ambient tensor-calculus preservation clause supplies bounded constructibility. Specialize the coefficient parameter to each finite subfield and to the closure.

proof_origin.place: Uniform Lean induction with explicitly composed restricted adjunctions and ambient tensor comparisons, E1.

Defines the smallest coproduct-closed triangulated hull used to extend twist preservation from bounded generators.

Specifies module pullback via the strong monoidal inverse image on abelian sheaves and scalar transport, used only for tensoring with a line.
Supplies the natural composition comparison of exact module inverse images; applying it termwise yields the comparison on the derived localizing categories.
Supplies the right adjoints on the localizing categories and their uniqueness, needed to write out the formal mate argument and the zero-dimensional base case.

Compares the chosen identity compactification in the exceptional-adjoint definition with the identity compactification used to calculate the zero-dimensional base case; the existence theorem alone does not assert this comparison.
